question: Rename the Annotations field in ObjectMeta (embedded in ResourceMeta) from Annotations to MetadataAnnotations in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml. ResourceMeta is returned by RNode.GetMeta() and ObjectMeta.Annotations is accessed by downstream code for reading YAML resource annotations. Renaming this field breaks any code that accesses meta.Annotations via the embedded ObjectMeta.
